original: 3. Mahāparinibbānasuttaṃ
content: 長部16經/般涅槃大經(大品[第二])(莊春江譯)

original: 131. Evaṃ me sutaṃ– ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
content: [[evaṃ me sutaṃ#被我這麼聽聞]]：[[ekaṃ samayaṃ#有一次]]，[[bhagavā#世尊]]住在王舍城[[gijjhakūṭe pabbate#耆闍崛山]]。

original: Tena kho pana samayena rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto vajjī abhiyātukāmo hoti.
content: 當時，摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子想要攻打跋耆，

original: So evamāha–
content: 他這麼說[AN.7.22]：

original: ‘‘ ahaṃ hime vajjī evaṃmahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve ucchecchāmi[ ucchejjāmi( syā. pī.), ucchijjāmi( ka.)] vajjī, vināsessāmi vajjī, anayabyasanaṃ āpādessāmi vajjī’’ ti[ āpādessāmi vajjīti( sabbattha) a. ni.7.22 passitabbaṃ].
content: 「我將要破壞這些這麼[[mahiddhikā#大神通力]]、這麼大威力的跋耆，我將要使跋耆滅亡，我將要使跋耆人來到不幸、災難。」(131)

original: 132. Atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto vassakāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ magadhamahāmattaṃ āmantesi–
content: 那時，摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子召喚摩揭陀國大臣作雨者[[brāhmaṇaṃ#婆羅門]]：

original: ‘‘ ehi tvaṃ, brāhmaṇa, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkama;
content: 「來！婆羅門！請你去見世尊。

original: upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandāhi, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha–
content: 抵達後，請你以我的名義[[nipaccakāraṃ#以頭禮拜世尊的足]]，請你詢問少病、少病苦、起居輕快、有力、[[phāsuvihāro#安樂住]]：

original: ‘ rājā, bhante, māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatī’ ti.
content: 『[[bhante#大德]]！摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子以頭禮拜世尊的足，他詢問：少病、少病苦、起居輕快、有力、安樂住？』

original: Evañca vadehi–
content: 以及請你這麼說：

original: ‘ rājā, bhante, māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto vajjī abhiyātukāmo.
content: 『大德！摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子想要攻打跋耆，

original: So evamāha–
content: 他這麼說：

original: ‘‘ ahaṃ hime vajjī evaṃmahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve ucchecchāmi vajjī, vināsessāmi vajjī, anayabyasanaṃ āpādessāmī’’’ ti.
content: 「我將要破壞這些這麼大神通力、這麼大威力的跋耆，我將要使跋耆滅亡，我將要使跋耆人來到不幸、災難。」』

original: Yathā te bhagavā byākaroti, taṃ sādhukaṃ uggahetvā mama āroceyyāsi.
content: 如世尊對你回答，善把握它後，你應該告訴我，

original: Na hi tathāgatā vitathaṃ bhaṇantī’’ ti.
content: 因為諸[[tathāgato#如來]]不說離真實的。」(132)

original: Vassakārabrāhmaṇo
content: 作雨者婆羅門

original: 133.‘‘ Evaṃ, bho’’ ti kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto rañño māgadhassa ajātasattussa vedehiputtassa paṭissutvā bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni yojetvā bhaddaṃ bhaddaṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā bhaddehi bhaddehi yānehi rājagahamhā niyyāsi, yena gijjhakūṭo pabbato tena pāyāsi.
content: 「是的，[[bho#先生]]！」摩揭陀國大臣作雨者婆羅門回答摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子後，準備一輛輛吉祥車、登上一輛輛吉祥車後，以一輛輛吉祥車從王舍城出發，前往耆闍崛山。

original: Yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi, yānena gantvā, yānā paccorohitvā pattikova yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami;
content: 以車輛一直走到車輛所及之地、再下車後，就步行去見世尊。

original: upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
content: 抵達後，與世尊一起互相問候。

original: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
content: 交換應該被互相問候的友好交談後，在一旁坐下。

original: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca–
content: 在一旁坐下的摩揭陀國大臣作雨者婆羅門對世尊說這個：

original: ‘‘ rājā, bho gotama, māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto bhoto gotamassa pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati.
content: 「[[gotama#喬達摩]]尊師！摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子以頭禮拜喬達摩尊師的足，他詢問：少病、少病苦、起居輕快、有力、安樂住？

original: Rājā[ evañca vadeti rājā( ka.)], bho gotama, māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto vajjī abhiyātukāmo.
content: 喬達摩尊師！摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子想要攻打跋耆，

original: So evamāha–
content: 且這麼說：

original: ‘ ahaṃ hime vajjī evaṃmahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve ucchecchāmi vajjī, vināsessāmi vajjī, anayabyasanaṃ āpādessāmī’’’ ti.
content: 『我將要破壞這些這麼大神通力、這麼大威力的跋耆，我將要使跋耆滅亡，我將要使跋耆人來到不幸、災難。』」(133)

original: Rājaaparihāniyadhammā
content: 國王的不衰退法

original: 134. Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ānando bhagavato piṭṭhito ṭhito hoti bhagavantaṃ bījayamāno[ vījayamāno( sī.), vījiyamāno( syā.)].
content: 當時，[[āyasmā#尊者]]阿難站在世尊的背後對世尊搧著風。

original: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi–
content: 那時，世尊召喚尊者阿難：

original: ‘‘ kinti te, ānanda, sutaṃ,‘ vajjī abhiṇhaṃ sannipātā sannipātabahulā’ ti?
content: 「阿難！是否被你聽聞：跋耆人將是經常聚集的、多聚集的？」

original: ‘‘ Sutaṃ metaṃ, bhante–
content: 「大德！這被我聽聞：

original: ‘ vajjī abhiṇhaṃ sannipātā sannipātabahulā’’ ti.
content: 『跋耆人將是經常聚集的、多聚集的。』」

original: ‘‘ Yāvakīvañca, ānanda, vajjī abhiṇhaṃ sannipātā sannipātabahulā bhavissanti, vuddhiyeva, ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 「阿難！只要跋耆人將是經常聚集的、多聚集的，阿難！跋耆的增長能被預期，非減損。」

original: ‘ ‘ Kinti te, ānanda, sutaṃ ,‘ vajjī samaggā sannipatanti, samaggā vuṭṭhahanti, samaggā vajjikaraṇīyāni karontī’ ti?
content: 「阿難！是否被你聽聞：『跋耆人和合地聚集，和合地出來，和合地作跋耆人應該做的事？』」

original: ‘‘ Sutaṃ metaṃ, bhante–
content: 「大德！這被我聽聞：

original: ‘ vajjī samaggā sannipatanti, samaggā vuṭṭhahanti, samaggā vajjikaraṇīyāni karontī’’ ti.
content: 『跋耆人和合地聚集，和合地出來，和合地作跋耆人應該做的事。』」

original: ‘‘ Yāvakīvañca, ānanda, vajjī samaggā sannipatissanti, samaggā vuṭṭhahissanti, samaggā vajjikaraṇīyāni karissanti, vuddhiyeva, ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 「阿難！只要跋耆人和合地聚集，和合地出來，和合地作跋耆人應該做的事，阿難！跋耆的增長能被預期，非減損。」

original: ‘ ‘ Kinti te, ānanda, sutaṃ,‘ vajjī apaññattaṃ na paññapenti, paññattaṃ na samucchindanti, yathāpaññatte porāṇe vajjidhamme samādāya vattantī’’’ ti?
content: 「阿難！是否被你聽聞：『跋耆人不[[paññāpeti#安立]]沒被安立的，不斷絕已被安立的，依往昔跋耆人所安立的法[[samādāya vattantīti#受持後轉起]]？』」

original: ‘‘ Sutaṃ metaṃ, bhante–
content: 「大德！這被我聽聞：

original: ‘ vajjī apaññattaṃ na paññapenti, paññattaṃ na samucchindanti, yathāpaññatte porāṇe vajjidhamme samādāya vattantī’’’ ti.
content: 『跋耆人不安立沒被安立的，不斷絕已被安立的，依往昔跋耆人所安立的法受持後轉起。』」

original: ‘‘ Yāvakīvañca, ānanda,‘‘ vajjī apaññattaṃ na paññapessanti, paññattaṃ na samucchindissanti, yathāpaññatte porāṇe vajjidhamme samādāya vattissanti, vuddhiyeva, ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 「阿難！只要跋耆人不安立沒被安立的，不斷絕已被安立的，依往昔跋耆人所安立的法受持後轉起，阿難！跋耆的增長能被預期，非減損。」

original: ‘ ‘ Kinti te, ānanda, sutaṃ,‘ vajjī ye te vajjīnaṃ vajjimahallakā, te sakkaronti garuṃ karonti[ garukaronti( sī. syā. pī.)] mānenti pūjenti, tesañca sotabbaṃ maññantī’’’ ti?
content: 「阿難！是否被你聽聞：『跋耆人恭敬、尊重、尊敬、崇敬那些跋耆的跋耆高齡者，且認為他們的應該被聽聞 ？』」

original: ‘‘ Sutaṃ metaṃ, bhante–
content: 「大德！這被我聽聞：

original: ‘ vajjī ye te vajjīnaṃ vajjimahallakā, te sakkaronti garuṃ karonti mānenti pūjenti, tesañca sotabbaṃ maññantī’’’ ti.
content: 『跋耆人恭敬、尊重、尊敬、崇敬那些跋耆的跋耆高齡者，且認為他們的應該被聽聞。』」

original: ‘‘ Yāvakīvañca, ānanda, vajjī ye te vajjīnaṃ vajjimahallakā , te sakkarissanti garuṃ karissanti mānessanti pūjessanti, tesañca sotabbaṃ maññissanti, vuddhiyeva, ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 「阿難！只要跋耆人恭敬、尊重、尊敬、崇敬那些跋耆的跋耆高齡者，且認為他們的應該被聽聞，阿難！跋耆的增長能被預期，非減損。」

original: ‘ ‘ Kinti te, ānanda, sutaṃ,‘ vajjī yā tā kulitthiyo kulakumāriyo, tā na okkassa pasayha vāsentī’’’ ti?
content: 「阿難！是否被你聽聞：『跋耆人不對那些良家婦人、良家少女拉、強迫後使居住？』」

original: ‘‘ Sutaṃ metaṃ, bhante–
content: 「大德！這被我聽聞：

original: ‘ vajjī yā tā kulitthiyo kulakumāriyo tā na okkassa pasayha vāsentī’’’ ti.
content: 『跋耆人不對那些良家婦人、良家少女拉、強迫後使居住。』」

original: ‘‘ Yāvakīvañca, ānanda, vajjī yā tā kulitthiyo kulakumāriyo, tā na okkassa pasayha vāsessanti, vuddhiyeva, ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 「阿難！只要跋耆人不對那些良家婦人、良家少女拉、強迫後使居住，阿難！跋耆的增長能被預期，非減損。」

original: ‘ ‘ Kinti te, ānanda, sutaṃ,‘ vajjī yāni tāni
content: 「阿難！是否被你聽聞：『跋耆人

original: Vajjīnaṃ vajjicetiyāni abbhantarāni ceva bāhirāni ca, tāni sakkaronti garuṃ karonti mānenti pūjenti, tesañca dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ dhammikaṃ baliṃ no parihāpentī’’’ ti?
content: 恭敬、尊重、尊敬、崇敬那些跋耆的跋耆[[cetiye#塔廟]]：內部的連同外部的，且不使那些先前施與的、先前作的合法的供品衰損？』」

original: ‘‘ Sutaṃ metaṃ, bhante–
content: 「大德！這被我聽聞：

original: ‘ vajjī yāni tāni vajjīnaṃ vajjicetiyāni abbhantarāni ceva bāhirāni ca, tāni sakkaronti garuṃ karonti mānenti pūjenti tesañca dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ dhammikaṃ baliṃ no parihāpentī’’’ ti.
content: 『跋耆人恭敬、尊重、尊敬、崇敬那些跋耆的跋耆塔廟：內部的連同外部的，且不使那些先前施與的、先前作的合法的供品衰損。』」

original: ‘‘ Yāvakīvañca, ānanda, vajjī yāni tāni vajjīnaṃ vajjicetiyāni abbhantarāni ceva bāhirāni ca, tāni sakkarissanti garuṃ karissanti mānessanti pūjessanti, tesañca dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ dhammikaṃ baliṃ no parihāpessanti, vuddhiyeva, ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 「阿難！只要跋耆人恭敬、尊重、尊敬、崇敬那些跋耆的跋耆塔廟：內部的連同外部的，且不使那些先前施與的、先前作的合法的供品衰損，阿難！跋耆的增長能被預期，非減損。」

original: ‘ ‘ Kinti te, ānanda, sutaṃ,‘ vajjīnaṃ arahantesu dhammikā rakkhāvaraṇagutti susaṃvihitā, kinti anāgatā ca arahanto vijitaṃ āgaccheyyuṃ, āgatā ca arahanto vijite phāsu vihareyyun’’’ ti?
content: 「阿難！是否被你聽聞：『跋耆人在[[arahaṃ#阿羅漢]]上有如法的、善安排的守護、防護、保護：如何未到達的阿羅漢會來到跋耆，已到達的阿羅漢會在跋耆[[phāsuvihāro#住於安樂]]？』」

original: ‘‘ Sutaṃ metaṃ, bhante‘ vajjīnaṃ arahantesu dhammikā rakkhāvaraṇagutti susaṃvihitā kinti anāgatā ca arahanto vijitaṃ āgaccheyyuṃ, āgatā ca arahanto vijite phāsu vihareyyun’’’ ti.
content: 「大德！這被我聽聞：『跋耆人在阿羅漢上有如法的、善安排的守護、防護、保護：如何未到達的阿羅漢會來到跋耆，已到達的阿羅漢會在跋耆住於安樂？』」

original: ‘‘ Yāvakīvañca, ānanda, vajjīnaṃ arahantesu dhammikā rakkhāvaraṇagutti susaṃvihitā bhavissati, kinti anāgatā ca arahanto vijitaṃ āgaccheyyuṃ, āgatā ca arahanto vijite phāsu vihareyyunti.
content: 「阿難！只要跋耆人在阿羅漢上有如法的、善安排的守護、防護、保護：如何未到達的阿羅漢會來到跋耆，已到達的阿羅漢會在跋耆住於安樂？

original: Vuddhiyeva, ānanda, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihānī’’ ti.
content: 阿難！跋耆的增長能被預期，非減損。」(134)

original: 135. Atha kho bhagavā vassakāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ magadhamahāmattaṃ āmantesi–
content: 那時，世尊召喚摩揭陀國大臣作雨者婆羅門：

original: ‘‘ ekamidāhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, samayaṃ vesāliyaṃ viharāmi sārandade[ sānandare( ka.)] cetiye.
content: 「婆羅門！有這一次，我住在毘舍離沙愣達達塔廟。

original: Tatrāhaṃ vajjīnaṃ ime satta aparihāniye dhamme desesiṃ.
content: 婆羅門！在那裡，我教導跋耆人這七[[aparihāniyā dhammā#不衰退法]]。

original: Yāvakīvañca, brāhmaṇa, ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā vajjīsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu vajjī sandississanti, vuddhiyeva, brāhmaṇa, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihānī’’ ti.
content: 婆羅門！只要這七不衰退法在跋耆中住立，以及跋耆人在這七不衰退法上被看見，婆羅門！跋耆的增長能被預期，非減損。」

original: Evaṃ vutte, vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca–
content: 在這麼說時，摩揭陀國大臣作雨者婆羅門對世尊說這個：

original: ‘‘ ekamekenapi, bho gotama, aparihāniyena dhammena samannāgatānaṃ vajjīnaṃ vuddhiyeva pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni .
content: 「喬達摩尊師！即使只具備一不衰退法，跋耆的增長就能被預期，非減損，

original: Ko pana vādo sattahi aparihāniyehi dhammehi.
content: 更不用說七不衰退法。

original: Akaraṇīyāva[ akaraṇīyā ca( syā. ka.)], bho gotama, vajjī[ vajjīnaṃ( ka.)] raññā māgadhena ajātasattunā vedehiputtena yadidaṃ yuddhassa, aññatra upalāpanāya aññatra mithubhedā.
content: 喬達摩尊師！跋耆就不應該被摩揭陀國阿闍世王韋提希子做，即：以戰爭，[[aññatra upalāpanāya#除非以欺騙]]，除非以失和。

original: Handa ca dāni mayaṃ, bho gotama, gacchāma , bahukiccā mayaṃ bahukaraṇīyā’’ ti.
content: 好了，喬達摩尊師！而現在我們離開(走)，我們有許多工作、許多應該被做的 。」

original: ‘‘ Yassadāni tvaṃ, brāhmaṇa, kālaṃ maññasī’’ ti.
content: 「婆羅門！現在是那個[[kālaṃ maññasī#你考量的時間]]。」

original: Atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
content: 那時，摩揭陀國大臣作雨者婆羅門歡喜、[[anumodana#隨喜]]世尊所說後，從座位起來後離開。(135)

original: Bhikkhuaparihāniyadhammā
content: 比丘的不衰退法

original: 136. Atha kho bhagavā acirapakkante vassakāre brāhmaṇe magadhamahāmatte āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi–
content: 那時，在摩揭陀國大臣作雨者婆羅門離開不久，世尊召喚尊者阿難：

original: ‘‘ gaccha tvaṃ, ānanda, yāvatikā bhikkhū rājagahaṃ upanissāya viharanti, te sabbe upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannipātehī’’ ti.
content: 「阿難！請你去，[[bhikkhu#比丘]]依止王舍城住之所及，請你使他們全部集合到講堂。」

original: ‘‘ Evaṃ, bhante’’ ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paṭissutvā yāvatikā bhikkhū rājagahaṃ upanissāya viharanti, te sabbe upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannipātetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami;
content: 「是的，大德！」尊者阿難回答世尊後，比丘依止王舍城住之所及，使他們全部集合到講堂後，去見世尊。

original: upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
content: 抵達後，向世尊[[abhivādetvā#問訊]]後，在一旁站立。

original: Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca–
content: 在一旁站立的尊者阿難對世尊說這個：

original: ‘‘ sannipatito, bhante, bhikkhusaṅgho, yassadāni, bhante, bhagavā kālaṃ maññatī’’ ti.
content: 「大德！比丘[[saṅgha#僧團]]已經集合，大德！現在是那個世尊考量的時間。」

original: Atha kho bhagavā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena upaṭṭhānasālā tenupasaṅkami;
content: 那時，世尊去講堂。

original: upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
content: 抵達後，在設置的座位坐下。

original: Nisajja kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi–
content: 坐下後，世尊召喚比丘們[AN.7.23]：

original: ‘‘ satta vo, bhikkhave, aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi, taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī’’ ti.
content: 「比丘們！我將為你們教導七不衰退法，你們要聽它！你們[[sādhukaṃ manasi karotha#要好好作意]]！我將說。」

original: ‘‘ Evaṃ, bhante’’ ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
content: 「是的，[[bhante#大德]]！」那些比丘回答世尊。

original: Bhagavā etadavoca–
content: 世尊說這個：

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca , bhikkhave, bhikkhū abhiṇhaṃ sannipātā sannipātabahulā bhavissanti, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 「比丘們！只要比丘們將是經常聚集的、多聚集的，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū samaggā sannipatissanti, samaggā vuṭṭhahissanti, samaggā saṅghakaraṇīyāni karissanti , vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要比丘們和合地聚集、和合地出來、和合地作比丘應該做的事，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū apaññattaṃ na paññapessanti, paññattaṃ na samucchindissanti, yathāpaññattesu sikkhāpadesu samādāya vattissanti, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要比丘們不安立沒被安立的，不斷絕已被安立的，依所安立的[[sikkhāpadaṃ#學處]]受持後轉起，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghapariṇāyakā, te sakkarissanti garuṃ karissanti mānessanti pūjessanti, tesañca sotabbaṃ maññissanti, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要比丘們恭敬、尊重、尊敬、崇敬那些有經驗的、長久出家的[[thāvareyya#上座]]比丘、[[saṅghapitaro#僧團父]]、僧團指導者，且認為他們的應該被聽聞，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū uppannāya taṇhāya ponobbhavikāya na vasaṃ gacchissanti, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要比丘們不走入已生起、[[nandirāgasahagatā#導致再有的渴愛]]的控制，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū āraññakesu senāsanesu sāpekkhā bhavissanti, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要比丘們是在諸林野住處上的期待者，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū paccattaññeva satiṃ upaṭṭhapessanti–
content: 比丘們！只要比丘們就使各自的念現起：

original: ‘ kinti anāgatā ca pesalā sabrahmacārī āgaccheyyuṃ, āgatā ca pesalā sabrahmacārī phāsu[ phāsuṃ( sī. syā. pī.)] vihareyyun’ ti.
content: 是否未到達的[[pesalā#美善]][[sabrahmacārī#同梵行者]]會到來，已到達的美善同梵行者會住於安樂，

original: Vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandississanti, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要這七不衰退法在諸比丘中住立，以及諸比丘在這七不衰退法上被看見，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。(136)

original: 137.‘‘ Aparepi vo, bhikkhave, satta aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi, taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī’’ ti.
content: 比丘們！其次，我還將為你們教導七不衰退法，你們要聽它！你們要好好作意！我將說。」

original: ‘‘ Evaṃ, bhante’’ ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
content: 「是的，大德！」那些比丘回答世尊。

original: Bhagavā etadavoca–
content: 世尊說這個：

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū na kammārāmā bhavissanti na kammaratā na kammārāmatamanuyuttā, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 「比丘們！只要比丘們是不[[kammārāmatā#樂於工作者]]、不好於工作者、[[kammārāmatamanuyuttā#不致力喜於工作者]]，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。[AN.7.24]

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū na bhassārāmā bhavissanti na bhassaratā na bhassārāmatamanuyuttā, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要比丘們是不樂於談話者、不好於談話者、不致力喜於談話者，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū na niddārāmā bhavissanti na niddāratā na niddārāmatamanuyuttā, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要比丘們是不樂於睡眠者、不好於睡眠者、不致力喜於睡眠者，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū na saṅgaṇikārāmā bhavissanti na saṅgaṇikaratā na saṅgaṇikārāmatamanuyuttā, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要比丘們是不樂於聚會者、不好於聚會者、不致力喜於聚會者，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū na pāpicchā bhavissanti na pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ vasaṃ gatā, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要比丘們是不惡欲求者、不落入諸惡欲求控制者，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū na pāpamittā bhavissanti na pāpasahāyā na pāpasampavaṅkā, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要比丘們沒有惡的朋友、惡的同伴、惡的親密朋友，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū na oramattakena visesādhigamena antarāvosānaṃ āpajjissanti, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要比丘們[[na oramattakena visesādhigamena antarāvosānaṃ āpajjissanti#不以低劣量殊勝的到達來到終結的中途]]，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandississanti, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要這七不衰退法在諸比丘中住立，以及諸比丘在這七不衰退法上被看見，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。(137)

original: 138.‘‘ Aparepi vo, bhikkhave, satta aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi… pe…‘‘ yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū saddhā bhavissanti… pe… hirimanā bhavissanti… ottappī bhavissanti… bahussutā bhavissanti… āraddhavīriyā bhavissanti… upaṭṭhitassatī bhavissanti… paññavanto bhavissanti, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！其次，我還將為你們教導另外的七不衰退法……（中略）[AN.7.25]。比丘們！只要比丘們是有信者……（中略）是有慚者……（中略）是有愧者……（中略）是多聞者……（中略）是活力已發動者……（中略）是[[upaṭṭhitā sati#念已現起]]者……（中略）是有慧者，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandississanti, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要這七不衰退法在諸比丘中住立，以及諸比丘在這七不衰退法上被看見，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。(138)

original: 139.‘‘ Aparepi vo, bhikkhave, satta aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi, taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī’’ ti.
content: 比丘們！其次，我還將為你們教導七不衰退法，你們要聽它！你們要好好作意！我將說。」

original: ‘‘ Evaṃ, bhante’’ ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
content: 「是的，大德！」那些比丘回答世尊。

original: Bhagavā etadavoca–
content: 世尊說這個：

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāvessanti… pe… dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāvessanti… vīriyasambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāvessanti… pītisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāvessanti… passaddhisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāvessanti… samādhisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāvessanti… upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāvessanti, vuddhiyeva , bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 「比丘們！只要比丘們[[bhāveti#修習]][[satisambojjhaṅgo#念覺支]]……（中略）修習[[dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo#擇法覺支]]……修習[[vīriyasambojjhaṅgo#活力覺支]]……修習[[pītisambojjhaṅgo#喜覺支]]……修習[[passaddhi#寧靜覺支]]……修習定覺支……修習[[upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo#平靜覺支]]，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損[AN.7.26]。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandississanti, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要這七不衰退法在諸比丘中住立，以及諸比丘在這七不衰退法上被看見，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。(139)

original: 140.‘‘ Aparepi vo, bhikkhave, satta aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi, taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī’’ ti.
content: 比丘們！其次，我還將為你們教導七不衰退法，你們要聽它！你們要好好作意！我將說。」

original: ‘‘ Evaṃ, bhante’’ ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
content: 「是的，大德！」那些比丘回答世尊。

original: Bhagavā etadavoca–
content: 世尊說這個：

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū aniccasaññaṃ bhāvessanti… pe… anattasaññaṃ bhāvessanti… asubhasaññaṃ bhāvessanti… ādīnavasaññaṃ bhāvessanti… pahānasaññaṃ bhāvessanti… virāgasaññaṃ bhāvessanti… nirodhasaññaṃ bhāvessanti, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 「比丘們！只要比丘們修習無常想……（中略）修習無我想……修習不淨想……修習[[ādīnavo#過患]]想……修習捨斷想……修習[[virāgo#離貪]]想……修習[[nirodhaṃ#滅]]想，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損[AN.7.27]。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca , bhikkhave, ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandississanti, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要這七不衰退法在諸比丘中住立，以及諸比丘在這七不衰退法上被看見，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。(140)

original: 141.‘‘ Cha, vo bhikkhave, aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi, taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī’’ ti.
content: 比丘們！我將為你們教導六不衰退法，你們要聽它！你們要好好作意！我將說。」

original: ‘‘ Evaṃ, bhante’’ ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
content: 「是的，大德！」那些比丘回答世尊。

original: Bhagavā etadavoca–
content: 世尊說這個[≃AN.6.11]：

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca , bhikkhave, bhikkhū mettaṃ kāyakammaṃ paccupaṭṭhāpessanti sabrahmacārīsu āvi ceva raho ca, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 「比丘們！只要比丘們對同梵行者公開地連同私下地使[[mettaṃ kāyakammaṃ#慈身業]]現起，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū mettaṃ vacīkammaṃ paccupaṭṭhāpessanti … pe… mettaṃ manokammaṃ paccupaṭṭhāpessanti sabrahmacārīsu āvi ceva raho ca, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要比丘們對同梵行者公開地連同私下地使慈語業現起……（中略）對同梵行者公開地連同私下地使慈意業現起，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū, ye te lābhā dhammikā dhammaladdhā antamaso pattapariyāpannamattampi tathārūpehi lābhehi appaṭivibhattabhogī bhavissanti sīlavantehi sabrahmacārīhi sādhāraṇabhogī, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要凡那些[[lābhā dhammikā dhammaladdhā#如法所得的如法利得]]，乃至連鉢裡(鉢繫屬)的量，比丘們是以像這樣利得平等受用者、與持有同梵行者共同受用者，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū yāni kāni sīlāni akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññūpasatthāni[ viññuppasatthāni( sī.)] aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni tathārūpesu sīlesu sīlasāmaññagatā viharissanti sabrahmacārīhi āvi ceva raho ca, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！凡那些無毀壞的、無瑕疵的、無污點的、無雜色的、自由的、智者稱讚的、不取著的、轉起定的戒，只要比丘們在像這樣的諸戒上與同梵行者們公開地連同私下地住於[[sīlasāmaññagatā#戒達到一致的]]，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū yāyaṃ diṭṭhi ariyā niyyānikā, niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāya, tathārūpāya diṭṭhiyā diṭṭhisāmaññagatā viharissanti sabrahmacārīhi āvi ceva raho ca, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
content: 比丘們！只要比丘們對所有這聖的、[[nissāraṇīyā dhātuyo#出離的]]見引導那樣的行為者苦的完全滅盡，比丘在像這樣的見上與同梵行者們公開地連同私下地住於見達到一致的，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。

original: ‘ ‘ Yāvakīvañca , bhikkhave, ime cha aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca chasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandississanti, vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihānī’’ ti.
content: 比丘們！只要這六不衰退法在諸比丘中住立，以及諸比丘在這六不衰退法上被看見，比丘們！比丘們的增長能被預期，非減損。」(141)

original: 142. Tatra sudaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharanto gijjhakūṭe pabbate etadeva bahulaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ karoti–
content: 在那裡，當世尊住在王舍城耆闍崛山時，就對比丘們多作這個法說：

original: ‘‘ iti sīlaṃ, iti samādhi, iti paññā.
content: 「像這樣是戒，像這樣是定，像這樣是慧。

original: Sīlaparibhāvito samādhi mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso.
content: 戒被遍修習，定有大果、[[mahapphalā mahānisaṃsā#大效益]]；

original: Samādhiparibhāvitā paññā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā.
content: 定被遍修習，慧有大果、大效益；

original: Paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sammadeva āsavehi vimuccati, seyyathidaṃ– kāmāsavā, bhavāsavā, avijjāsavā’’ ti.
content: 慧被遍修習，心就完全地從諸[[avassuto#漏]]被解脫，即：欲漏、有漏、[[kāmāsavo#無明漏]]。」(142)

original: 143. Atha kho bhagavā rājagahe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi–
content: 那時，世尊如其意地住在王舍城後，召喚尊者阿難：

original: ‘‘ āyāmānanda, yena ambalaṭṭhikā tenupasaṅkamissāmā’’ ti.
content: 「阿難！我們走，我們將去芒果樹苖圃。」

original: ‘‘ Evaṃ, bhante’’ ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
content: 「是的，大德！」尊者阿難回答世尊。

original: Atha kho bhagavā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena ambalaṭṭhikā tadavasari.
content: 那時，世尊與大比丘僧團一起抵達芒果樹苖圃。

original: Tatra sudaṃ bhagavā ambalaṭṭhikāyaṃ viharati rājāgārake.
content: 在那裡，世尊住在國王的芒果樹苖圃。

original: Tatrāpi sudaṃ bhagavā ambalaṭṭhikāyaṃ viharanto rājāgārake etadeva bahulaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ karoti–
content: 在那裡，當世尊住在國王的芒果樹苖圃時，就也對比丘們多作這個法說：

original: ‘‘ iti sīlaṃ iti samādhi iti paññā.
content: 「像這樣是戒，像這樣是定，像這樣是慧。

original: Sīlaparibhāvito samādhi mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso.
content: 戒被遍修習，定有大果、大效益；

original: Samādhiparibhāvitā paññā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā.
content: 定被遍修習，慧有大果、大效益；

original: Paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sammadeva āsavehi vimuccati, seyyathidaṃ– kāmāsavā, bhavāsavā, avijjāsavā’’ ti.
content: 慧被遍修習，心就完全地從諸漏被解脫，即：欲漏、有漏、無明漏。」(143)

original: 144. Atha kho bhagavā ambalaṭṭhikāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi–
content: 那時，世尊如其意地住在國王的芒果樹苖圃後，召喚尊者阿難：

original: ‘‘ āyāmānanda, yena nāḷandā tenupasaṅkamissāmā’’ ti.
content: 「阿難！我們走，我們將去那爛陀。」

original: ‘‘ Evaṃ, bhante’’ ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
content: 「是的，大德！」尊者阿難回答世尊。

original: Atha kho bhagavā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena nāḷandā tadavasari, tatra sudaṃ bhagavā nāḷandāyaṃ viharati pāvārikambavane .
content: 那時，世尊與大比丘僧團一起去那爛陀。在那裡，世尊住在那爛陀賣衣者的芒果園中。(144)

original: Sāriputtasīhanādo
content: 舍利弗的獅子吼

original: 145. Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami;
content: 那時，尊者舍利弗去見世尊。

original: upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
content: 抵達後，向世尊問訊後，在一旁坐下。

original: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca–
content: 在一旁坐下的尊者舍利弗對世尊說這個[SN.47.12, DN.28, 141-143段]：

original: ‘‘ evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ, bhante, bhagavati;
content: 「大德！我在世尊上有這樣的[[pasannaṃ#淨信]]：

original: na cāhu na ca bhavissati na cetarahi vijjati añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyobhiññataro yadidaṃ sambodhiyan’’ ti.
content: 不曾有與將沒有，以及現在不存在其他[[samaṇa#沙門]]或[[brāhmaṇaṃ#婆羅門]]比世尊更高證智的，即：[[sambodhi#正覺]]。」

original: ‘‘ Uḷārā kho te ayaṃ, sāriputta, āsabhī vācā[ āsabhivācā( syā.)] bhāsitā, ekaṃso gahito, sīhanādo nadito–
content: 「舍利弗！這偉大的、取[[ekanta, ekaṃso#一向的]]、吼獅子吼的[[āsabhī vācā#如牛王之語]]被你說：

original: ‘ evaṃpasanno ahaṃ, bhante, bhagavati;
content: 『大德！我在世尊上有這樣的淨信：

original: na cāhu na ca bhavissati na cetarahi vijjati añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyobhiññataro yadidaṃ sambodhiyan’ ti.
content: 不曾有與將沒有，以及現在不存在其他沙門或婆羅門比世尊更高的證智，即：正覺。』

original: ‘ ‘ Kiṃ te[ kiṃ nu( syā. pī. ka.)], sāriputta, ye te ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, sabbe te bhagavanto cetasā ceto paricca viditā–
content: 舍利弗！凡那些存在於過去世的[[arahaṃ#阿羅漢]]、[[sammāsambuddhaṃ#遍正覺者]]，那一切世尊被你[[cetasā ceto paricca#以心熟知心後]]知道：

original: ‘ evaṃsīlā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipi, evaṃdhammā evaṃpaññā evaṃvihārī evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto ahesuṃ itipī’’’ ti?
content: 『那些世尊是這樣戒者。』……[[evaṃdhammā#這樣法者]]……這樣慧者……[[evaṃvihārī#這樣住處者]]……『那些世尊是[[evaṃvimuttā#這樣解脫者]]。』嗎？」

original: ‘‘ No hetaṃ, bhante’’.
content: 「大德！這確實不是。」

original: ‘ ‘ Kiṃ pana te[ kiṃ pana( syā. pī. ka.)], sāriputta, ye te bhavissanti anāgatamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, sabbe te bhagavanto cetasā ceto paricca viditā–
content: 「舍利弗！又，凡那些存在於未來世的阿羅漢、遍正覺者，那一切世尊被你以心熟知心後知道：

original: ‘ evaṃsīlā te bhagavanto bhavissanti itipi, evaṃdhammā evaṃpaññā evaṃvihārī evaṃvimuttā te bhagavanto bhavissanti itipī’’’ ti?
content: 『那些世尊將有這樣的戒。』這樣的法……這樣慧者……這樣的住處者……『那些世尊將是這樣的解脫者。』嗎？」

original: ‘‘ No hetaṃ, bhante’’.
content: 「大德！這確實不是。」

original: ‘ ‘ Kiṃ pana te, sāriputta, ahaṃ etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho cetasā ceto paricca vidito–
content: 「舍利弗！又，我現在阿羅漢、遍正覺者被你以心熟知心後知道：

original: ‘‘ evaṃsīlo bhagavā itipi , evaṃdhammo evaṃpañño evaṃvihārī evaṃvimutto bhagavā itipī’’’ ti?
content: 『世尊有這樣的戒。』這樣的法……這樣慧者……這樣的住處者……『那些世尊是這樣的解脫者。』嗎？」

original: ‘‘ No hetaṃ, bhante’’.
content: 「大德！這確實不是。」

original: ‘ ‘ Ettha ca hi te, sāriputta, atītānāgatapaccuppannesu arahantesu sammāsambuddhesu cetopariyañāṇaṃ[ cetopariññāyañāṇaṃ( syā.), cetasā cetopariyāyañāṇaṃ( ka.)] natthi.
content: 「舍利弗！而在這裡，你在過去、未來、現在阿羅漢、遍正覺者們上沒有[[cetopariyañāṇaṃ#他心智]]，

original: Atha kiñcarahi te ayaṃ, sāriputta, uḷārā āsabhī vācā bhāsitā, ekaṃso gahito, sīhanādo nadito–
content: 舍利弗！那麼，那樣的話，為何偉大的、取一向的、吼獅子吼的如牛王之語被你說：

original: ‘ evaṃpasanno ahaṃ, bhante, bhagavati;
content: 『大德！我在世尊上有這樣的淨信：

original: na cāhu na ca bhavissati na cetarahi vijjati añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyobhiññataro yadidaṃ sambodhiyan’’’ ti?
content: 不曾有與將沒有，以及現在不存在其他沙門或婆羅門比世尊更高的證智，即：正覺。』呢？」(145)

original: 146.‘‘ Na kho me, bhante, atītānāgatapaccuppannesu arahantesu sammāsambuddhesu cetopariyañāṇaṃ atthi, api ca me dhammanvayo vidito.
content: 「大德！我在過去、未來、現在阿羅漢、遍正覺者們上沒有他心智，但[[dhammanvayo#法的類比]]被我知道。

original: Seyyathāpi, bhante, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ daḷhuddhāpaṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇaṃ ekadvāraṃ, tatrassa dovāriko paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā.
content: 大德！猶如國王邊境的城市，有堅固的壁壘，堅固的城牆與城門，只有一個門，在那裡，有賢智的、聰明的、有智慧的、對不認識的制止的、對認識的使進入的守門人。

original: So tassa nagarassa samantā anupariyāyapathaṃ[ anucariyāyapathaṃ( syā.)] anukkamamāno na passeyya pākārasandhiṃ vā pākāravivaraṃ vā, antamaso biḷāranikkhamanamattampi.
content: 沿那個城市全部環繞道路走的他沒看見甚至連貓出去大小的城牆間隙或裂口，

original: Tassa evamassa[ na passeyya tassa evamassa( syā.)]–
content: 他這麼想：

original: ‘ ye kho keci oḷārikā pāṇā imaṃ nagaraṃ pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā, sabbe te imināva dvārena pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā’ ti.
content: 『凡任何粗大的生物進入或出去這個城市，他們全部僅經由這個門進入或出去。』

original: Evameva kho me, bhante, dhammanvayo vidito–
content: 同樣的，大德！法的類比被我知道：

original: ‘ ye te, bhante, ahesuṃ atītamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā , sabbe te bhagavanto pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacittā sattabojjhaṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhiṃsu.
content: 『大德！凡那些存在於過去世的阿羅漢、遍正覺者；那些世尊全部捨斷心的[[upakkilesā#隨雜染]]、[[paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe#慧的減弱的]][[pañca nīvaraṇā#五蓋]]後，在[[cattāro satipaṭṭhānā#四念住]]上心善建立，如實修習[[satta bojjhaṅgā#七覺支]]後，[[abhisambuddho#現正覺]][[anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ#無上遍正覺]]。

original: Yepi te, bhante, bhavissanti anāgatamaddhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā , sabbe te bhagavanto pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacittā satta bojjhaṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhissanti.
content: 大德！凡那些將存在於未來世的阿羅漢、遍正覺者；那些世尊全部也捨斷心的隨雜染、慧的減弱之五蓋後，在四念住上心善建立，如實修習七覺支後，將現正覺無上遍正覺。

original: Bhagavāpi, bhante, etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacitto satta bojjhaṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho’’’ ti.
content: 大德！現在的世尊、阿羅漢、遍正覺者也捨斷心的隨雜染、慧的減弱之五蓋後，在四念住上心善建立，如實修習七覺支後，現正覺無上遍正覺。』」(146)

original: 147. Tatrapi sudaṃ bhagavā nāḷandāyaṃ viharanto pāvārikambavane etadeva bahulaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ karoti–
content: 又，在那裡，當世尊住在那爛陀賣衣者的芒果園中時，就對比丘們多作這個法說：

original: ‘‘ iti sīlaṃ, iti samādhi, iti paññā.
content: 「像這樣是戒，像這樣是定，像這樣是慧。

original: Sīlaparibhāvito samādhi mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso.
content: 戒被遍修習，定有大果、大效益；

original: Samādhiparibhāvitā paññā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā.
content: 定被遍修習，慧有大果、大效益；

original: Paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sammadeva āsavehi vimuccati, seyyathidaṃ– kāmāsavā, bhavāsavā, avijjāsavā’’ ti.
content: 慧被遍修習，心就完全地從諸漏被解脫，即：欲漏、有漏、無明漏。」(147)

original: Dussīlaādīnavā
content: 破戒的過患

original: 148. Atha kho bhagavā nāḷandāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi–
content: 那時，世尊如其意地住在那爛陀後，召喚尊者阿難：

original: ‘‘ āyāmānanda, yena pāṭaligāmo tenupasaṅkamissāmā’’ ti.
content: 「阿難！我們走，我們將去巴吒釐村。」

original: ‘‘ Evaṃ, bhante’’ ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi .
content: 「是的，大德！」尊者阿難回答世尊。

original: Atha kho bhagavā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena pāṭaligāmo tadavasari.
content: 那時，世尊與大比丘僧團一起抵達巴吒釐村。

original: Assosuṃ kho pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā–
content: 巴吒釐村的[[upāsaka#優婆塞]]們聽聞[Ud.76]：

original: ‘‘ bhagavā kira pāṭaligāmaṃ anuppatto’’ ti.
content: 「聽說世尊已抵達巴吒釐村。」

original: Atha kho pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu;
content: 那時，巴吒釐村的優婆塞們去見世尊。

original: upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
content: 抵達後，向世尊問訊後，在一旁坐下。

original: Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ–
content: 在一旁坐下的巴吒釐村的優婆塞們對世尊說這個：

original: ‘‘ adhivāsetu no, bhante, bhagavā āvasathāgāran’’ ti.
content: 「大德！請世尊同意[到]我們的招待所。」

original: Adhivāsesi bhagavā tuṇhībhāvena.
content: 世尊以沈默狀態同意。

original: Atha kho pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena āvasathāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu;
content: 那時，巴吒釐村的優婆塞們知道世尊同意了後，從座位起來、向世尊問訊、[[padakkhiṇaṃ katvā#作右繞]]後，去招待所。

original: upasaṅkamitvā sabbasanthariṃ [ sabbasantharitaṃ satthataṃ( syā.), sabbasanthariṃ santhataṃ( ka.)] āvasathāgāraṃ santharitvā āsanāni paññapetvā udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā telapadīpaṃ āropetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
content: 抵達後，鋪設招待所的一切鋪設物、設置諸座位、使水瓶設立、懸掛油燈後，去見世尊。抵達後，向世尊問訊後，在一旁站立。

original: Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ–
content: 在一旁站立的巴吒釐村的優婆塞們對世尊說這個：

original: ‘‘ sabbasantharisanthataṃ[ sabbasanthariṃ santhataṃ( sī. syā. pī. ka.)], bhante, āvasathāgāraṃ, āsanāni paññattāni, udakamaṇiko patiṭṭhāpito, telapadīpo āropito;
content: 「大德！招待所的一切鋪設物已鋪設，諸座位已設置，已使水瓶設立，油燈已懸掛，

original: yassadāni, bhante, bhagavā kālaṃ maññatī’’ ti.
content: 大德！現在是那個世尊考量的時間。」

original: Atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ[ idaṃ padaṃ vinayamahāvagga na dissati].
content: 那時，世尊傍晚時，

original: Nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena āvasathāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkami;
content: 穿衣、拿起衣鉢後，與比丘僧團一起去招待所。

original: upasaṅkamitvā pāde pakkhāletvā āvasathāgāraṃ pavisitvā majjhimaṃ thambhaṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho[ puratthimābhimukho( ka.)] nisīdi.
content: 抵達後，使腳洗滌、進入招待所後，依止中央柱子面向東坐下，

original: Bhikkhusaṅghopi kho pāde pakkhāletvā āvasathāgāraṃ pavisitvā pacchimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi bhagavantameva purakkhatvā.
content: 比丘僧團也使腳洗滌、進入集會所後，依止西邊牆壁面向東，置世尊在前面後坐下，

original: Pāṭaligāmikāpi kho upāsakā pāde pakkhāletvā āvasathāgāraṃ pavisitvā puratthimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya pacchimābhimukhā nisīdiṃsu bhagavantameva purakkhatvā.
content: 巴吒釐村的優婆塞們使腳洗滌、進入招待所後，依止東邊牆壁面向西，面對世尊坐下。(148)

original: 149. Atha kho bhagavā pāṭaligāmike upāsake āmantesi–
content: 那時，世尊召喚巴吒釐村的優婆塞們：

original: ‘‘ pañcime, gahapatayo, ādīnavā dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
content: 「屋主們！有這破戒者以戒壞失的五種[[ādīnavo#過患]][AN.5.213]，

original: Katame pañca?
content: 哪五種？

original: Idha, gahapatayo, dussīlo sīlavipanno pamādādhikaraṇaṃ mahatiṃ bhogajāniṃ nigacchati.
content: 屋主們！這裡，破戒者、戒壞失者因為放逸而遭受大財產的損失，

original: Ayaṃ paṭhamo ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
content: 這是第一種破戒者以戒壞失的過患。

original: ‘ ‘ Puna caparaṃ, gahapatayo, dussīlassa sīlavipannassa pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati.
content: 再者，屋主們！破戒者以戒壞失的惡名聲傳播，

original: Ayaṃ dutiyo ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
content: 這是第二種破戒者以戒壞失的過患。

original: ‘ ‘ Puna caparaṃ, gahapatayo, dussīlo sīlavipanno yaññadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati– yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ– avisārado upasaṅkamati maṅkubhūto.
content: 再者，屋主們！破戒者、戒壞失者往見任何群眾：不論[[khattiya#剎帝利]]眾，不論婆羅門眾，不論[[gahapati#屋主眾]]，不論沙門眾，他無自信地、羞愧地往見，

original: Ayaṃ tatiyo ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
content: 這是第三種破戒者以戒壞失的過患。

original: ‘ ‘ Puna caparaṃ, gahapatayo, dussīlo sīlavipanno sammūḷho kālaṅkaroti.
content: 再者，屋主們！破戒者、戒壞失者癡昧地命終，

original: Ayaṃ catuttho ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
content: 這是第四種破戒者以戒壞失的過患。

original: ‘ ‘ Puna caparaṃ, gahapatayo, dussīlo sīlavipanno kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati.
content: 再者，屋主們！破戒者、戒壞失者以身體的崩解，死後往生[[apāyaṃ#苦界]]、[[gacchanti duggatiṃ#惡趣]]、[[vinipātaṃ#下界]]、地獄，

original: Ayaṃ pañcamo ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
content: 這是第五種破戒者以戒壞失的過患。

original: Ime kho, gahapatayo, pañca ādīnavā dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
content: 屋主們！這是破戒者以戒壞失的五種過患。(149)

original: Sīlavanttaānisaṃsā
content: 持戒的效益

original: 150.‘‘ Pañcime , gahapatayo, ānisaṃsā sīlavato sīlasampadāya.
content: 屋主們！有這持戒者以戒具足的五種效益，

original: Katame pañca?
content: 哪五種？

original: Idha, gahapatayo, sīlavā sīlasampanno appamādādhikaraṇaṃ mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ adhigacchati.
content: 屋主們！這裡，持戒者、戒具足者因為不放逸而到達大財產的聚集，

original: Ayaṃ paṭhamo ānisaṃso sīlavato sīlasampadāya.
content: 這是第一種持戒者以戒具足的效益。

original: ‘ ‘ Puna caparaṃ, gahapatayo, sīlavato sīlasampannassa kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati.
content: 再者，屋主們！持戒者、戒具足者的好名聲傳播，

original: Ayaṃ dutiyo ānisaṃso sīlavato sīlasampadāya.
content: 這是第二種持戒者以戒具足的效益。

original: ‘ ‘ Puna caparaṃ, gahapatayo, sīlavā sīlasampanno yaññadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati– yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ visārado upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto.
content: 再者，屋主們！持戒者、戒具足者往見任何群眾：不論剎帝利眾，不論婆羅門眾，不論屋主眾，不論沙門眾，他有自信地、不羞愧地往見，

original: Ayaṃ tatiyo ānisaṃso sīlavato sīlasampadāya.
content: 這是第三種持戒者以戒具足的效益。

original: ‘ ‘ Puna caparaṃ, gahapatayo, sīlavā sīlasampanno asammūḷho kālaṅkaroti.
content: 再者，屋主們！持戒者、戒具足者不癡昧地命終，

original: Ayaṃ catuttho ānisaṃso sīlavato sīlasampadāya.
content: 這是第四種持戒者以戒具足的效益。

original: ‘ ‘ Puna caparaṃ, gahapatayo, sīlavā sīlasampanno kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
content: 再者，屋主們！持戒者、戒具足者以身體的崩解，死後往生[[sugati#善趣]]、天界，

original: Ayaṃ pañcamo ānisaṃso sīlavato sīlasampadāya.
content: 這是第五種持戒者以戒具足的效益。

original: Ime kho, gahapatayo, pañca ānisaṃsā sīlavato sīlasampadāyā’’ ti.
content: 屋主們！這是持戒者以戒具足的五種效益。(150)

original: 151. Atha kho bhagavā pāṭaligāmike upāsake bahudeva rattiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uyyojesi–
content: 那時，世尊對巴吒釐村的優婆塞們大部分夜晚以法說開示、勸導、鼓勵、[[sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti#使歡喜]]後，使離開：

original: ‘‘ abhikkantā kho, gahapatayo, ratti, yassadāni tumhe kālaṃ maññathā’’ ti.
content: 「屋主們！夜已過，現在是那個你們考量的時間。」

original: ‘‘ Evaṃ, bhante’’ ti kho pāṭaligāmikā upāsakā bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu.
content: 「是的，大德！」巴吒釐村的優婆塞們回答世尊後，從座位起來、向世尊問訊、作右繞後離開。

original: Atha kho bhagavā acirapakkantesu pāṭaligāmikesu upāsakesu suññāgāraṃ pāvisi.
content: 那時，世尊在巴吒釐村優婆塞們離開不久，進入空屋。(151)

original: Pāṭaliputtanagaramāpanaṃ
content: 華氏城的建築

original: 152. Tena kho pana samayena sunidhavassakārā[ sunīdhavassakārā( syā. ka.)] magadhamahāmattā pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpenti vajjīnaṃ paṭibāhāya.
content: 當時，摩揭陀國大臣蘇尼大與作雨者為了防止跋耆人，在巴吒釐村建築城市。

original: Tena samayena sambahulā devatāyo sahasseva[ sahassasseva( sī. pī. ka.), sahassaseva( ṭīkāyaṃ pāṭhantaraṃ), sahassasahasseva( udānaṭṭhakathā)] pāṭaligāme vatthūni pariggaṇhanti.
content: 當時，眾多的，甚至千位天神在巴吒釐村佔取諸宅地：

original: Yasmiṃ padese mahesakkhā devatā vatthūni pariggaṇhanti, mahesakkhānaṃ tattha raññaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
content: 凡在大影響力天神佔取宅地處，大影響力國王、國王大臣的心傾向在那裡建築住處；

original: Yasmiṃ padese majjhimā devatā vatthūni pariggaṇhanti, majjhimānaṃ tattha raññaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
content: 凡在中等天神佔取宅地處，中等[影響力]國王、國王大臣的心傾向在那裡建築住處；

original: Yasmiṃ padese nīcā devatā vatthūni pariggaṇhanti, nīcānaṃ tattha raññaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
content: 凡在低等天神佔取宅地處，低等國王、國王大臣的心傾向在那裡建築住處。

original: Addasā kho bhagavā dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena tā devatāyo sahasseva pāṭaligāme vatthūni pariggaṇhantiyo.
content: 世尊以清淨、超越常人的天眼看見在巴吒釐村佔取宅地的那些甚至千位天神。

original: Atha kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi–
content: 那時，世尊在破曉時起來後，召喚尊者阿難：

original: ‘‘ ke nu kho[ ko nu kho( sī. syā. pī. ka.)], ānanda, pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpentī’’ ti[ māpetīti( sī. syā. pī. ka.)]?
content: 「阿難！誰在巴吒釐村建築城市呢？」

original: ‘‘ Sunidhavassakārā, bhante, magadhamahāmattā pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpenti vajjīnaṃ paṭibāhāyā’’ ti.
content: 「大德！摩揭陀國大臣蘇尼大與作雨者為了防止跋耆人，在巴吒釐村建築城市。」

original: ‘‘ Seyyathāpi, ānanda, devehi tāvatiṃsehi saddhiṃ mantetvā, evameva kho, ānanda, sunidhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā pāṭaligāme nagaraṃ māpenti vajjīnaṃ paṭibāhāya.
content: 「阿難！猶如與三十三天一起商量後，阿難！就這樣，摩揭陀國大臣蘇尼大與作雨者為了防止跋耆人，在巴吒釐村建築城市。

original: Idhāhaṃ, ānanda, addasaṃ dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena sambahulā devatāyo sahasseva pāṭaligāme vatthūni pariggaṇhantiyo.
content: 阿難！這裡，我以清淨、超越常人的天眼看見眾多的，甚至千位天神在巴吒釐村佔取諸宅地：

original: Yasmiṃ , ānanda, padese mahesakkhā devatā vatthūni pariggaṇhanti, mahesakkhānaṃ tattha raññaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
content: 凡在大影響力天神佔取宅地處，大影響力國王、國王大臣的心傾向在那裡建築住處；

original: Yasmiṃ padese majjhimā devatā vatthūni pariggaṇhanti, majjhimānaṃ tattha raññaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
content: 凡在中等天神佔取宅地處，中等國王、國王大臣的心傾向在那裡建築住處；

original: Yasmiṃ padese nīcā devatā vatthūni pariggaṇhanti, nīcānaṃ tattha raññaṃ rājamahāmattānaṃ cittāni namanti nivesanāni māpetuṃ.
content: 凡在低等天神佔取宅地處，低等國王、國王大臣的心傾向在那裡建築住處。

original: Yāvatā, ānanda, ariyaṃ āyatanaṃ yāvatā vaṇippatho idaṃ agganagaraṃ bhavissati pāṭaliputtaṃ puṭabhedanaṃ .
content: 阿難！亞利安人之所及處；貿易(商人路)之所及，這將是第一城市，華氏城將是財貨集散地。

original: Pāṭaliputtassa kho, ānanda, tayo antarāyā bhavissanti– aggito vā udakato vā mithubhedā vā’’ ti.
content: 阿難！華氏城的三個障礙將是：火[災]，或水，或失和。」(152)

original: 153. Atha kho sunidhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu;
content: 那時，摩揭陀國大臣蘇尼大與作雨者去見世尊。

original: upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu, sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu, ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sunidhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ–
content: 抵達後，與世尊一起互相問候。交換應該被互相問候的友好交談後，在一旁站立。在一旁站立的摩揭陀國大臣蘇尼大與作雨者對世尊說這個：

original: ‘‘ adhivāsetu no bhavaṃ gotamo ajjatanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā’’ ti.
content: 「請喬達摩尊師與比丘僧團一起同意我們的今天的食事。」

original: Adhivāsesi bhagavā tuṇhībhāvena.
content: 世尊以沈默狀態同意。

original: Atha kho sunidhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā yena sako āvasatho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu;
content: 那時，摩揭陀國大臣蘇尼大與作雨者知道世尊同意後，回自己的住處。

original: upasaṅkamitvā sake āvasathe paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesuṃ–
content: 抵達後，在自己的住處準備勝妙的[[khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ#硬食、軟食]]，使[人]為世尊通知時間：

original: ‘‘ kālo, bho gotama, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan’’ ti.
content: 「喬達摩尊師！是時間，食事已完成。」

original: Atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena sunidhavassakārānaṃ magadhamahāmattānaṃ āvasatho tenupasaṅkami;
content: 那時，世尊午前時穿衣、拿起衣鉢後，與比丘僧團一起去摩揭陀國大臣蘇尼大與作雨者的住處。

original: upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
content: 抵達後，在設置的座位坐下。

original: Atha kho sunidhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesuṃ sampavāresuṃ.
content: 那時，摩揭陀國大臣蘇尼大與作雨者以勝妙的[[khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ#硬食、軟食]]親手款待以佛陀為上首的比丘僧團，使滿足。

original: Atha kho sunidhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
content: 那時，對已食、手離鉢的世尊，摩揭陀國大臣蘇尼大與作雨者取某個低的坐具後，在一旁坐下。

original: Ekamantaṃ nisinne kho sunidhavassakāre magadhamahāmatte bhagavā imāhi gāthāhi anumodi–
content: 世尊以這些偈頌感謝在一旁坐下的摩揭陀國大臣蘇尼大與作雨者：

original: ‘ ‘ Yasmiṃ padese kappeti, vāsaṃ paṇḍitajātiyo;
content: 「在凡地方建造，賢智類者們住所，

original: Sīlavantettha bhojetvā, saññate brahmacārayo[ brahmacārino( syā.)].
content: 在這裡宴請持戒者們，已抑制者們、梵行者們。

original: ‘ ‘ Yā tattha devatā āsuṃ, tāsaṃ dakkhiṇamādise;
content: 凡在那裡已有諸天神，應該為祂們獻上供養，

original: Tā pūjitā pūjayanti[ pūjitā pūjayanti naṃ( ka.)], mānitā mānayanti naṃ.
content: 那些被供養者供養，被服侍者服侍他。

original: ‘ ‘ Tato naṃ anukampanti, mātā puttaṃva orasaṃ;
content: 因此祂們憐憫他，如母親對親生的兒子，

original: Devatānukampito poso, sadā bhadrāni passatī’’ ti.
content: 諸天神憐憫的人，經常看見諸吉祥。」

original: Atha kho bhagavā sunidhavassakāre magadhamahāmatte imāhi gāthāhi anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
content: 那時，世尊以這些偈頌感謝摩揭陀國大臣蘇尼大與作雨者後，從座位起來後離開。(153)

original: 154. Tena kho pana samayena sunidhavassakārā magadhamahāmattā bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhā honti–
content: 當時，摩揭陀國大臣蘇尼大與作雨者在世尊後面緊跟隨：

original: ‘‘ yenajja samaṇo gotamo dvārena nikkhamissati, taṃ gotamadvāraṃ nāma bhavissati.
content: 「現在，凡沙門喬達摩將離開所經之門，那個門將名為喬達摩門；

original: Yena titthena gaṅgaṃ nadiṃ tarissati, taṃ gotamatitthaṃ nāma bhavissatī’’ ti.
content: 凡將渡恒河所經之渡場，那個渡場將名為喬達摩渡場。」

original: Atha kho bhagavā yena dvārena nikkhami , taṃ gotamadvāraṃ nāma ahosi.
content: 那時，世尊離開所經之門，那個門名為喬達摩門。

original: Atha kho bhagavā yena gaṅgā nadī tenupasaṅkami.
content: 那時，世尊去恒河之渡場。

original: Tena kho pana samayena gaṅgā nadī pūrā hoti samatittikā kākapeyyā.
content: 當時，恒河是滿的、滿到邊緣的、能被烏鴉喝飲的。

original: Appekacce manussā nāvaṃ pariyesanti, appekacce uḷumpaṃ pariyesanti, appekacce kullaṃ bandhanti apārā[ pārā( sī. syā. ka.), orā( vi. mahāvagga)], pāraṃ gantukāmā.
content: 一些人遍求船，一些人遍求筏，一些人捆綁籠筏，想要從此岸到彼岸。

original: Atha kho bhagavā– seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evameva– gaṅgāya nadiyā orimatīre antarahito pārimatīre paccuṭṭhāsi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
content: 那時，世尊就猶如有力氣的男子伸直彎曲的手臂，或彎曲伸直的手臂，就像這樣在恒河此岸消失，與比丘僧團一起出現在恒河彼岸。

original: Addasā kho bhagavā te manusse appekacce nāvaṃ pariyesante appekacce uḷumpaṃ pariyesante appekacce kullaṃ bandhante apārā pāraṃ gantukāme.
content: 那時，世尊看見那些人：一些人遍求船，一些人遍求筏，一些人捆綁籠筏，想要從此岸到彼岸。

original: Atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi–
content: 那時，世尊知道這件事後，那時候吟出[[udānaṃ#優陀那]]：

original: ‘ ‘ Ye taranti aṇṇavaṃ saraṃ, setuṃ katvāna visajja pallalāni;
content: 「凡渡過河流湖泊：建造橋後捨離泥沼後，

original: Kullañhi jano bandhati[ kullaṃ jano ca bandhati( syā.), kullaṃ hi jano pabandhati( sī. pī. ka.)], tiṇṇā[ nitiṇṇā, na tiṇṇā( ka.)] medhāvino janā’’ ti.
content: 人人捆綁籠筏，有智慧的人已渡過。」(154)

original: Paṭhamabhāṇavāro .
content: 初誦分[終了]。
